The '''Galactic Olympics''' was a type of event celebrated in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] arrived at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], he remarked that he hadn't seen so many [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] in one place since he watched the Galactic Olympics on a [[Holovid/Legends|Holovid]].<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
